notes.title: 9-nine-:Episode 4 Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611534/95c4c1d1cfcb1916b3b733dfa5e5d6cc6850ae05.jpg[/img]
We're so exited to let you know that 9-nine-:Episode 4 is now available on Steam! We hope you enjoy your time with the 9nine series. We've also added a bundle on Steam where you can get Episode 1-3 with an extra discount. Episode 4 will be joining this bundle at a later date, so do keep an eye out for that. Thank you for playing and enjoying the series, we appreciate all of your support.
